files.title: File management
files.movingHint: Moving your library. Please don't close the app.

unavailable.notFound: Library not found. Choose its location in Settings → File management.
unavailable.network: The library is on a network drive and can't be opened. Choose a local folder in Settings → File management.
unavailable.cloudSync: The library is in a cloud-sync folder and can't be opened. Choose a local folder in Settings → File management.
unavailable.schemaTooNew: This library was created by a newer version of the app (v{{found}}). This version supports up to v{{supported}}. Please update the app.

choose.libraryNotFound: Library not found. Choose where dialogue audio is stored.
choose.networkDriveDenied: A library can't be stored on a network drive. Choose a local folder.
choose.cloudSyncDenied: A library can't be stored in a cloud-sync folder. Choose a local folder.
choose.targetNotEmpty: This folder already has other files, so a library can't be created here.
choose.targetInsideLibrary: A library can't be moved into its own folder.
choose.busy: The library is being moved. Please wait.
